project.name: Book Management System
project.techStack: Spring Boot 3.x (Java 21, Maven, JPA, Flyway, H2 file DB) backend; React + TypeScript + Vite frontend

decisions.decision: Git repository initialized locally; no remote configured.
Technology stack to be recommended by the Architecture specialist and approved by the user.
Stack: Spring Boot 3.x backend (Java 21, Maven, Spring Web, Spring Data JPA, Flyway, H2 file DB) and React + TypeScript + Vite frontend.

MCP servers configured in workspace-root .mcp.json: atlassian (Jira and Confluence, https://mcp.atlassian.com/v2/mcp) and github (https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/), read-only, OAuth sign-in, no secrets in files.
docs/architecture.md approved by user; Stage 2 complete. Next stage: Design Review.

Design Review approved by user: DR-01 unique author names (case-insensitive, 409); DR-02 single POST /books with inline newAuthor in one transaction; DR-03 optimistic locking (version, 409); DR-04 Spring Boot serves React build (no CORS); DR-05 bind to localhost, no auth as accepted risk; DR-06 to DR-14 applied. Stage 3 complete. Next stage: Implementation Planning.

Hand-written Spring Boot 3.5.16 pom.xml because Spring Initializr returned HTTP 400 for 3.x; static UI build output git-ignored; HTTP 405 mapped to VALIDATION_ERROR (confirmed by user in code review F-09).

Code review resolutions, user authorized: F-01 ISBN format check removed to match A-04 (length limit kept); F-06 client sort removed, list uses server order after reload; F-09 405 mapping confirmed. Decided on the user's behalf and can be reversed. E2E 3 of 3 passed against the updated code.
